newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent firmer.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent firmer.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.10 cent firmer Wednesday, based on market orders at 1019 EDT, dealers said.

The speculators have begun to cover short positions, according to the weekly spec/hedge report. NYCE noted an 18.4 percent net short position was held by the speculators as of May 23, down about one percentage point from the previous week.
USDA said Tuesday that 77 percent of the cotton crop has been planted compared with 75 percent last year, and 77 percent according to a five-year average.

Tuesday, benchmark July settled at 72.97 cents a lb, up 0.66 cent, after trading from 73.00 to 72.30 cents. New-crop December closed 0.49 cent higher at 75.13 cents, while the outer months settled 0.55 to 0.05 cent higher.
An estimated 7,500 lots changed hands on the day.
